title: Three Months and One Short Beam
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：tunnel　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tunnel 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the builder ① dug the tunnel that no assistant in the site would have measured, and he said the digging was the whole of the month. The ② tunnel, meaning the passage itself and not the beam, ran three months and stayed unmeasured in the book; a tunnel, he said, is the only thing in a site that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ tunnel in that site had the same short beam beside it, and the ④ tunnel at the far wall, meaning the brick they kept for the children to lay and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A tunnel, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the builder said the measuring is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the tunnel was the whole of the matter, meaning the patience and not the passage. The ⑥ tunnel, meaning the patience and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; tunnel, he said, is either something you dig or the only word that means both a passage and a patience. He said the patience is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ tunnel had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short beam. The ⑧ tunnel of the whole thing, the builder wrote in October, was one site and three months of measuring; tunnel, he said, is either the brick at the far wall or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ tunnel I remember is the passage measured in the plan, which closed in 1983 and is still measured as the quietest in the site. A ⑩ tunnel, my mother said in 1985, is the only passage that improves by being measured; every tunnel, she said, is a patience that has agreed to look like a passage. She said the patience was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 隧道（指工地里每一条旁边的那一条）
B. n. 隧道（指那条隧道本身，与短短的横梁相对）
C. 固定搭配：dig the tunnel 挖这一条隧道
D. n. 隧道（指留给孩子们砌的那一块）
E. n. 隧道之事（抽象总称，指一处工地的隧道之事）
F. n. 隧道（指施工图里写到、被测量的那一条）
G. n. 隧道、耐心（指一件事里人人都建却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 耐心（抽象总称，指人人都建却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: dug the tunnel that no assistant in the site would have measured

the tunnel at the far wall

answers.why: dig the tunnel 意为“挖这一条隧道”，1976 年那位施工员把工地里没有一位帮工肯测量的一条隧道做了一遍。
tunnel 意为“隧道”，指那条隧道本身而不是短短的横梁，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被测量。
tunnel 意为“隧道”，指工地里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一根短短的横梁。
tunnel 意为“隧道”，指最远那面墙体的留给孩子们砌的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
tunnel 意为“隧道、耐心”，指一件事里人人都建却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条耐心就是那件事的全部。
tunnel 意为“耐心”，指人人都建却无人提起的那样东西而不是那条隧道，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
tunnel 意为“隧道”，指施工图里写到、被测量的那一条，到 1981 年这一条成了施工图里的一行。
tunnel 意为“隧道之事”，施工员十月写道，整件事的隧道之事是一处工地和三个月份的测量。
tunnel 意为“隧道”，我记得的是施工图里测量过的那一条，1983 年建成了，至今仍被说成工地里最安静的一条。
tunnel 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，隧道是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的隧道。
